connect.connectedNote: Connected, the coworker can use it
connect.signInNote: Sign in once so the coworker can use it

event.schedules: {count, plural, one {# schedule on} other {# schedules on}}
event.triggers: {count, plural, one {# trigger on} other {# triggers on}}
event.proposedNote: Proposed for review. Nothing changes until someone accepts it.

notes.saved: Saved. Every coworker reads it from its next run.
notes.deleted: No coworker reads it anymore. Its history is kept.
notes.accepted: Saved. Every coworker reads it from its next run.

published.asksPublic: {coworker} wants anyone with the link to open it

_context.agentPicker.open: A chip under a message of the Chief of Staff: opens one screen of a coworker. The words after Open are the names of the coworker's tabs.
_context.event.schedules: A badge on the card that says a coworker finished its setup: how many schedules are turned on.
_context.event.triggers: A badge on the card that says a coworker finished its setup: how many triggers are turned on.
_context.table.partial: How many rows of a table a card shows, out of the table's total.
_context.published.asksPublic: Under a page a coworker published: the coworker asks that anyone with the link may open it, without signing in. {coworker} is the coworker's name.
_context.published.keepPrivate: Button: refuse to make the published link public; it stays for the workspace's members.
_context.published.makePublic: Button: make the published link public, so anyone with the link can open it.
_context.published.madePublicByYou: Status under a published link once the user agreed to make it public.
_context.published.madePublic: Status under a published link that someone made public.
_context.published.keptFor: Status under a published link once the user refused to make it public. {workspace} is the name of the workspace.
_context.published.copy: Screen reader label of the button that copies the address of a published page.
_context.published.copied: Screen reader label of the copy button right after the address was copied.
_context.published.open: Screen reader label of the button that opens a published page.
_context.published.fallbackCoworker: Stands in for the name of a coworker that no longer exists.
_context.published.fallbackWorkspace: Stands in for the name of a workspace that has none.
_context.published.access.public: Screen reader label of the small badge on a published page's thumbnail: who can open the link. {workspace} in the workspace label is the name of the workspace.
